title: Seed real product catalog
context: Catalog must be real, not placeholder Lorem Ipsum data — pull from ARI/TaskDrift product info or a clearly-labeled test merchant persona.
objective: Seed Firestore (or an in-memory store if Firestore isn't wired for catalog yet) with 5 real-looking SKUs.
scope_in: 5 products with real names, prices in INR, descriptions
Seed script runnable independently of the API server
scope_out: No admin UI for catalog management — hardcoded/seeded is fine for this build
acceptance_criteria: GET /products returns exactly the 5 seeded SKUs, no placeholder text like 'Product 1'
Seed script is idempotent — running it twice doesn't duplicate products
